sections.heading: Built-Up Roofs vs. Shingles: Roofing Materials Compared for Belleville Homeowners

c.v: Are built-up roofs better than shingles?

runs.v: On flat and low-slope sections, yes: asphalt shingles need at least a 2:12 slope under the International Residential Code, while shingles stay the cost-effective pick on pitched roofs. BUR is a proven roofing system with exceptional waterproofing and durability, reliable protection against water intrusion, and UV protection that prevents premature degradation; it resists punctures and can stand up to impact, foot traffic, and everyday wear. Gravel cap layers add fire resistance, BUR systems can meet stringent fire-resistance and wind-uplift requirements, and built-up roofing has been used in the U.S. for more than 100 years, per NRCA.

faqs.q: Do you need a permit for a commercial built-up roof in Belleville, NJ?

runs.v: Yes, when repairs cover more than 25% of the roof area on a commercial, multi-family, or attached building within 12 months, under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7; a detached one- or two-family flat-roof recover counts as ordinary maintenance. Confirm with the Belleville construction office before work.

faqs.q: Does a Belleville historic building need extra approval for a built-up roof?

runs.v: It can. Confirm the property's local historic status with the Township of Belleville; properties in a historic district can need extra review. Per the National Park Service, National Register listing alone places no restriction on a private owner.

faqs.q: How long does a built-up roof last on a Belleville building?

runs.v: About 30 years, per the InterNACHI life-expectancy chart, and typically 20 to 30 years with proper maintenance.

faqs.q: Should you restore or replace a Belleville built-up roofing system?

runs.v: Restore when the plies hold and damage stays localized; replace past 25–30% membrane damage, per Modernize and HomeGuide, or when leaks recur at one detail, per HomeAdvisor. That is the 25% rule for roofing: past about a quarter of the roof, replacement usually beats patching, and on commercial, multi-family, and attached buildings it triggers a construction permit.

faqs.q: Can a Belleville built-up roof be converted to a single-ply membrane?

runs.v: Yes. Newark Quality Roofing strips the BUR to the decking and installs EPDM (15–25 years) or TPO (7–20 years), per InterNACHI; full removal applies when the roof is water-soaked or carries two or more layers, per N.J.A.C. 5:23-6.4.
